data.reply: Hi, thanks for reaching out and sorry for the trouble. v4.2 introduced a change in SSO token refresh mechanisms. For Okta/Azure AD, please ensure your IdP's application settings for CloudDesk have a 'Refresh Token' policy enabled and configured for a reasonable duration (e.g., 8-24 hours) to prevent premature session expiration. [T-764] Let us know if that does not resolve it.
